newsitem.title: USA: AMR not disputing pilot's role in 95 crash.
newsitem.headline: AMR not disputing pilot's role in 95 crash.

text.p: AMR Corp's American Airlines said on Friday that it did not dispute the pilot was a factor in Flight 965's crash into a Colombian mountain last December.
The aircraft crashed near Cali, Colombia, killing 159 people. Airline officials said it was caused by the flight captain's error and a mix-up in computer coordinates.
But American Airlines said it was disappointed the Colombian government's official report on the accident did not address certain issues.
In a final report released in Washington on Friday, Colombian officials said pilot errors caused the crash.

It said probable contributing causes were that the crew did not know how close the plane was to the ground and failed to revert to basic radio navigation when the computer navigation became confusing.
American said the official report did not address other factors that contributed to the crash and did not address aviation safety issues.
